notes: HL Commodity Foods manufactures functional cheese ingredients — cheese sauces, heat-stable cheese and natural cheese flavours — for industrial and foodservice buyers; no own food offer attributable through sale.
Key Ingredients Europe supplies seasoning blends, rusk and sausage and burger mixes to the meat trade; an ingredient supplier, not a producer with its own food offer.
Premier Molasses supplies molasses and liquid feeds for the animal feed sector; the output is not food or drink for human consumption.
Seeds Ireland retails organic vegetable and flower seed for growing; seed for sowing is not a food or drink product.
